title: Station Terminal Application Capability
statement: Provide interactive public terminals at selected railway stations allowing passengers to explore railway information without installing the mobile application.
evidence_excerpt: selected railway stations may contain interactive public terminals. These terminals should allow passengers to explore railway information without requiring them to install the passenger mobile application.

title: Station Terminal Deployment
statement: Design the station terminal as an application suitable for deployment on dedicated station devices.
evidence_excerpt: The terminal should be designed as an application suitable for deployment on dedicated station devices.

title: Station Terminal Technology and Interaction Model
statement: Determine the appropriate technology and interaction model for the station terminal application.
evidence_excerpt: You should determine the appropriate technology and interaction model.
clarification_question: What are the specific hardware constraints, accessibility standards, and preferred technology stacks for dedicated station devices?

title: Driver and Train Operator Application Access
statement: Provide train drivers and relevant operational personnel with access to a dedicated application supporting their operational responsibilities during a train journey.
evidence_excerpt: Train drivers or relevant train operational personnel should have access to a dedicated application. The application should support their operational responsibilities during a train journey.

title: Driver Application Scope and Permissions
statement: Investigate and define the information required by drivers and operators, and specify which information they should be permitted to update.
evidence_excerpt: You should investigate what information the driver or train operator would reasonably require and which information they should be permitted to update.
clarification_question: What are the regulatory and safety requirements governing what data a train operator is permitted to modify while on duty?

title: Railway Operations Platform
statement: Provide a web-based system for managing and overseeing railway operations that allows authorized users to understand what is currently happening across the railway network.
evidence_excerpt: The railway organization requires a web-based system for managing and overseeing railway operations. The operations platform should allow authorized users to understand what is currently happening across the railway network.

title: Operations Platform Roles and Responsibilities
statement: Identify appropriate user roles and responsibilities for the railway operations platform, supporting multiple access levels beyond a single administrator role.
evidence_excerpt: The users of this system should not simply be treated as a single Administrator role... You should identify appropriate user roles and responsibilities.
clarification_question: What is the complete organizational hierarchy and required permission matrix for each operational department?
